name: graduate-worker-contracts
title: Graduate worker contracts and funding policies at US universities
description: Pay rates, summer funding, tuition and fee waivers, health insurance, raises, unions, and union events for graduate student workers at US universities, from union contracts and, where no contract sets pay, published university funding policies. Every fact cites the document, page, and passage it comes from.

resources.name: fair_market_rents
resources.description: For each campus and academic year, the Fair Market Rents that the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) sets for the campus's area: the monthly rent, utilities included, that 40 percent of similar rentals in the area cost no more than. HUD fiscal year N is listed under academic year (N-1)-N.
